facts.text: The user asked for a JVZoo-style funnel with FE, OTO1, OTO2, OTO3, and OTO4.
The user requested downsell at OTO1.
The user requested recurring at OTO2.
The user asked what the price of each OTO should be.
The user asked whether a bundle offer like a JVZoo product style is possible.
The user asked what the price should be for the bundle offer.
The user asked what to do with OTO2 recurring if a customer buys it through the bundle.
The user asked whether it would be feasible and a good business decision.
